newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso hits record low vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso hits record low vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso fell 3.6 pesos to a record low of 1,110.80 against the dollar, interbank dealers said.
An influx of coffee export earnings and petro-dollars into the market failed to offset high dollar demand from banks looking to build up positions and demand from industry, dealers said.
They said the trend was toward a weakening peso but did not rule out the possibility that the peso could claw back slightly in the course of the week.
Dealers reported 349 trades worth $170 million. The peso opened at 1,108 and traded between an intra-day high of 1,107.65 and a low of 1,111.
